resources.name: Quantum ESPRESSO

access.notes: Open-source DFT code to perform total-energy calculations, geometry optimizations, and charge density analysis. The paper used VASP; Quantum ESPRESSO is a suitable open-source equivalent that supports periodic boundary conditions and GGA pseudopotentials.

resources.notes: DFT code to replace VASP; must support periodic boundary conditions and GGA pseudopotentials.

resources.name: GGA-PW91 pseudopotentials (PSlibrary or SSSP)

access.notes: PW91 or PBE pseudopotentials for W, Re, and H in UPF format. The paper used PW91; an equivalent GGA functional is acceptable.

resources.notes: Pseudopotentials must be in UPF format for Quantum ESPRESSO.

resources.name: Python 3 with numpy and pandas
resources.notes: Used for post-processing: compute energy differences, run the Polanyi-Wigner equation, and write CSV outputs.
